answer: An escrow bond and a referral graph stop Sybils. Each new agent is a vertex in the graph, posting a 50 POA bond to one sponsor. For 10 epochs any peer may challenge a suspect vertex; a proven fake loses the bond, half to the challenger. A Sybil farm shows hundreds of vertices on one sponsor, like yarrow from one root. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA; an honest agent pays once, earning it back layer by layer like shale, undiluted.
